title: Wooden NFC Business Card (Laser-Engraved) — FSC Veneer vCard Tap-Card for Architects, Luxury and Executive Programmes
summary: In real-world deployments, laser-engraved wooden NFC business cards use FSC / PEFC veneer (bamboo, walnut, cherry, maple) with an embedded NTAG216 inlay holding an NDEF vCard or URI record. Engraving at 10.6 μm CO2 wavelength produces permanent dark-brown logos, text and QR on the grain; the 888-byte NTAG216 payload covers full vCard 3.0 contact + website + social in a single tap. The bespoke B2B variant of the wooden-card SKU for architect studios, luxury-boutique founders, high-end realtors and executive exec-portfolio cards.
heroPoints: FSC / PEFC veneer (bamboo, walnut, cherry, maple) + CO2 laser engraving at 10.6 μm — permanent dark-brown marks, no ink, no fade.
NTAG216 (888 bytes) inlay carrying a vCard 3.0 NDEF record — one tap pushes name, title, phone, email, website and socials to the recipient's phone.
0.76–1.00 mm ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1 (or near-ID-1 bespoke) veneer sandwich — wallet-friendly, pocket-friendly, grain-unique every card.
imageAlt: Laser-engraved wooden NFC business card with FSC hardwood veneer and embedded NTAG216 chip

brief.label: Product positioning — B2B vCard tap-card
items: The engraved wooden business card is the bespoke B2B variant of the wooden-card family: lower volume (typical 100–500 per order), higher unit price, individualised engraving per person.
Unit value proposition is recipient retention — the card stays in a wallet or cardholder as a keepsake rather than being thrown away at end of meeting.
Functional payload is the NDEF vCard tap — one-touch push of contact data into the recipient's phone contacts.

brief.label: Wood species catalogue
items: Bamboo (Moso, compressed fiber) — the fastest-renewable substrate (3–5 year regrowth); uniform light-tan finish, cleanest engraving contrast.
Walnut (American black walnut) — dark chocolate grain, the premium executive choice; engraving produces a medium-brown mark on dark grain.
Cherry — warm red-brown tone that deepens to mahogany over the first year; favoured by architects, interior designers and wine estates.
Maple — pale cream grain with occasional fleck marks; highest engraving contrast and cleanest for fine-detail logos.

brief.label: CO2 laser engraving process
items: CO2 laser at 10.6 μm wavelength — the canonical wavelength for wood marking because wood's carbon structure absorbs strongly at that band.
Power 50–80 W; engraving speed 300–600 mm/s; spot size 0.1–0.3 mm depending on focus and focal length.
Depth 0.05–0.15 mm — enough to produce permanent contrast without compromising the veneer core, which typically sits at 0.25–0.35 mm thickness.

brief.label: Why CO2 not fibre laser
items: CO2 lasers at 10.6 μm match wood's absorption band; fibre lasers at 1.06 μm are optimal for metals and most polymers but not wood.
Fibre laser on wood tends to burn through rather than mark cleanly; CO2 produces the dark-brown controlled-charring effect that buyers recognise as wood engraving.
Metal business cards (stainless steel, brass) use fibre laser engraving instead — the wavelength match is reversed.

brief.label: Embedded inlay — NTAG216
items: NTAG216 (888 bytes user memory, NFC Forum Type 2) is the default — it's the smallest standard chip that fits a full vCard 3.0 + URI without fragmentation.
NTAG213 (144 bytes) is adequate for a short vCard (name + phone + URL only) when per-card cost is tight; NTAG215 (504 bytes) sits in between.
NTAG424 DNA (416 bytes) is the option when the vCard must be authenticated / tamper-evident — premium programmes guarding against cloned cards.

brief.label: NDEF payload layout
items: NDEF VCARD Record Type Definition (per NFC Forum NDEF 1.0) wraps a vCard 3.0 (RFC 2426) body — FN, N, TEL, EMAIL, URL, ORG, TITLE, ADR, NOTE.
Alternative: NDEF URI Record pointing to a landing page (Apple Business Connect profile, Google Business Profile, Calendly link, Linktree-style vCard-host).
Alternative: NDEF Smart Poster combining a short-form URI + a title — the minimal payload when wallet storage is the priority.

brief.label: Tap behaviour on iPhone and Android
items: iPhone 7+ with iOS 14+ reads the NDEF payload automatically (Background Tag Reading) when the card is tapped near the top-edge antenna; no app required.
Android (Jelly Bean 4.1+) reads NDEF via the NFC Services framework; the phone prompts to open the URL, save the vCard or handle the Smart Poster.
Typical read range 1–3 cm through the veneer; read success is unaffected by the wood substrate because wood is radio-transparent at 13.56 MHz.

brief.label: Card dimensions and construction
items: Standard: ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1 (85.6 × 54 × 0.76 mm) — fits all cardholders, wallets and card printers the recipient already owns.
Premium bespoke: 0.90–1.00 mm thickness for heavier-hand feel on executive-portfolio versions; custom non-ID-1 shapes for signature designs.
Construction: veneer top + RFID inlay core + veneer bottom, water-based polyurethane adhesive; matte / silk / gloss protective clear coat.

brief.label: Regulatory and chain-of-custody
items: FSC / PEFC Chain-of-Custody certified veneer; documentation shipped with every order.
EU Deforestation Regulation 2023/1115 (EUDR) due-diligence supported via FSC / PEFC CoC — relevant when the card is placed on the EU market.
CITES Appendix II Dalbergia rosewood species excluded from the catalogue.

brief.label: Personalisation workflow
items: Artwork intake: vector logo (SVG / AI / EPS), vCard field list (name, title, phone, email, URL, socials), optional QR code embedding the same URL as the NFC record.
Proof cycle: a physical sample card engraved with the design is shipped within 5–7 business days before production run.
Per-card individual engraving for personal-name programmes; per-design run engraving for studio-branded batches.

brief.label: Deployment archetypes
items: Architect and interior-design studios — walnut / cherry veneer cards as the client leave-behind at initial-consultation or pitch meetings.
Luxury-boutique founders — bamboo / maple cards for event-retail and showroom hand-off moments.
High-end realtors — walnut veneer cards as premium leave-behinds at open-house and broker-open events.
Executive exec-portfolio cards — C-suite and board-member cards with NTAG424 DNA for authenticated tap-to-vCard.
Sustainability-consulting firms — bamboo cards reinforcing the environmental-advisory brand at first client contact.

brief.label: Why wood beats plastic for this use-case
items: Recipient retention — wallet-carried veneer cards endure past the 30-day throw-away window that kills plastic card ROI.
Grain uniqueness — every card is visually different, compounding the keepsake effect.
Tactility — the physical feel of wood distinguishes the card from the dozens of plastic cards in a recipient's collection.
Sustainability narrative — the FSC CoC story is the passive brand signal every time the card is handled.

sections.title: Why the engraved wooden business card is a different product to the generic wooden access card
sections.intro: The engraved wooden NFC business card is specifically a B2B vCard tap-card. The functional payload is a single NDEF record that fires the recipient's phone into a contact-add or website-open flow. The packaging — walnut veneer, laser-engraved name and logo, ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1 card body — is what makes it survive past the 30-day throw-away window that kills most plastic cards.
paragraphs: The wooden-card family covers three product shapes. The generic eco-access card (rfid-wooden-card) is about being an access credential or loyalty card in a wooden substrate. The engraved business card (this SKU) is a personal vCard / URI tap-card where each card is engraved for a specific individual. The bamboo-card SKU covers the fastest-renewable substrate story explicitly. The three share FSC CoC, the same inlay ecosystem and the same ISO/IEC 7810 envelope, and differ on volume profile and decoration workflow.

CO2 laser engraving is what separates the engraved-business variant. Fine detail on walnut, cherry, bamboo and maple produces logos, names and QR codes that never fade, peel or smudge. The NDEF payload (typically a vCard 3.0 body or a URI record pointing to Apple Business Connect / Google Business Profile / Calendly) fires on tap, in iOS Background Tag Reading or Android NFC Services — no app install required.

sections.title: The NDEF tap — one action, full vCard 3.0 + URL delivered to the phone

dataHighlight.heading: NTAG216 + NDEF VCARD Record — the payload that fits 888 bytes
dataHighlight.text: A full vCard 3.0 body (RFC 2426) with FN, N, TEL, EMAIL, URL, ORG, TITLE, ADR and NOTE fits comfortably within the NTAG216's 888-byte user memory and is wrapped in a single NDEF VCARD Record (NFC Forum NDEF 1.0). On iPhone 7+ with iOS 14+ the tap fires Background Tag Reading: the phone auto-detects the tag and offers 'Add to Contacts' without an app install. On Android (Jelly Bean 4.1+) the NFC Services framework handles the same payload. NTAG213 (144 bytes) is tight for a full vCard; NTAG215 (504 bytes) fits most; NTAG216 (888 bytes) is the catalogue default because it removes the compromise.
dataHighlight.source: NFC Forum NDEF 1.0 + NFC Forum Record Type Definition VCARD + IETF RFC 2426 (vCard v3.0) + NXP NTAG216 datasheet

faq.question: Which chip should I choose — NTAG213, NTAG215, NTAG216 or NTAG424 DNA?
faq.answer: {chip:nxp-ntag-216:name} ({chip:nxp-ntag-216:user_bytes} bytes) is the catalogue default because it fits a full vCard 3.0 body with name, title, phone, email, URL, organisation, address and socials in one NDEF record. {chip:nxp-ntag-213:name} ({chip:nxp-ntag-213:user_bytes} bytes) is tight — only a short vCard or a URL fits. {chip:nxp-ntag-215:name} ({chip:nxp-ntag-215:user_bytes} bytes) sits in between and is fine for most single-executive cards. {chip:nxp-ntag-424-dna:name} ({chip:nxp-ntag-424-dna:user_bytes} bytes) is the premium choice when the card must be authenticated / tamper-evident against cloning.

faq.question: Can I update the NFC data after the cards are made?
faq.answer: Yes, if the NTAG chip is not write-locked at factory. Use the free NFC Tools app on any modern smartphone to rewrite the NDEF payload. The better pattern for long-term flexibility is to encode a URI record pointing to a landing page (Apple Business Connect, Google Business Profile, Calendly or a Linktree-style vCard host) — you then update the landing page without touching the physical cards.

faq.question: Why CO2 laser and not fibre laser?
faq.answer: CO2 lasers at 10.6 μm match wood's carbon absorption band and produce the controlled dark-brown charring that gives wood engraving its distinctive look. Fibre lasers at 1.06 μm are optimal for metals and most polymers but burn through wood rather than marking cleanly. For the metal-business-card SKU the wavelength choice reverses and fibre laser is correct.

faq.question: Are the cards durable enough for daily use?
faq.answer: Yes, with sensible expectations. Veneer cards have a 2–4 year wallet-carry life with clear-coat finish. They are not rated for laundry, marine or industrial-wash environments. The NFC chip is sealed between veneer layers and protected from impact; the laser engraving is permanent and never fades or peels.

faq.question: What is the minimum order for engraved wooden NFC business cards?
faq.answer: MOQ is 100 per design. For executive / exec-portfolio runs with per-person individual engraving we handle 50–99 piece orders at a small-batch pricing tier. Physical proof samples in the chosen wood species with a design engraving are shipped within 5–7 business days before production starts.
